gap_reasons.MANUAL_CONFLICT: Contradictory manual statements need an explicit interpretation and proof for that scope.
gap_reasons.MISSING_IMPLEMENTATION: A rejection is explicitly mapped to a documented form; a successful rejection test does not implement it. Undocumented call combinations prove boundaries only.
gap_reasons.MISSING_PROOF: The complete manual artifact has no direct conformance proof; implementation may be bounded or not assessed.

manual_decisions.decision: Section 4.12: positive Timeout without Default warns and keeps waiting; zero waits indefinitely.
